prompt: Implement the attached organization-wide Docker base image management brief; support Debian 11 bullseye, Debian 12 bookworm, Debian 13 trixie, Ubuntu 20.04 through 26.04 major LTS releases, opinionated framework images, and GitHub Actions publishing.
response: Added Debian, Ubuntu, React, and Vite catalog entries plus a manually triggered GHCR publication workflow that builds multi-architecture images with SBOM and provenance attestations. Framework images are opinionated Node.js 22/npm builders with npm run build and dist output, not production runtimes. Verified upstream digests remain release gates.
